description: Protect loved ones: pill reminders, missed alarm alerts & fall SOS 💊 PillSOS — The medication reminder you can't ignore, with SOS protection. Whether you are managing a daily treatment, taking vitamins, antibiotics, or simply want to track your pill schedule in total safety, PillSOS is your everyday companion. Care for yourself and your loved ones with an automatic medication schedule alarm and emergency SOS alerts. ─────────────── ✨ WHY PILLSOS IS DIFFERENT ─────────────── 🔔 FULL-SCREEN ALARM & VOICE PROMPT Never miss a dose again! Your screen lights up with an unmissable alert and, if your hands are busy, a voice reads out loudly which medicine you need to take. 🚨 FALL DETECTION & AUTOMATIC LIFE-SAVING SOS If your phone detects a sudden impact or fall, a countdown alarm triggers immediately. If you do not respond in time, an automatic help and emergency request is sent to your contacts. 👨‍👩‍👧 DESIGNED FOR CAREGIVERS & FAMILIES The ideal solution for peace of mind and care for parents, grandparents, or loved ones living alone. 🤝 CONNECT IN 5 SECONDS Want to sync with your trusted contacts? A simple 6-digit code is all it takes: zero accounts, zero sign-ups. If you miss a dose or an SOS alarm triggers, your linked contact receives an alert immediately. 💚 THE "I'M OK" BUTTON A quick tap to dismiss the alarm and confirm with peace of mind: "All good, I took my medicine and I'm okay!". 🌍 MULTI-LANGUAGE & REGIONAL DIALECTS Full, accurate translations in over 20 languages—including Neapolitan, Sicilian, and Romanesco—to make everyone feel right at home. 🔒 TOTAL PRIVACY No email, no passwords. Your medication schedules and sensitive health data stay stored exclusively on your phone. ─────────────── Download PillSOS today and go through your day with added peace of mind! 💚 ───────────────────── ℹ️ PillSOS is a reminder and personal safety tool for daily wellness; it is not a medical device and does not replace official emergency services.
